resources.string: Warden uses accessibility to detect when a blocked app or website is opened so it can show the block screen. Warden never collects, stores, or transmits the content of your screen.
Prevents Warden from being uninstalled while blocking is active. Warden requests no other admin powers.
Warden is a commercial, free-to-use app. A reserved ad slot may appear below the Home screen — never on block or pause screens. A paid plan (no ads, more power) arrives later.
Alerts you if Warden\'s protection is no longer active
App screening is no longer active — adult-content blocking is off. Tap to re-enable it.
A time lock is active, but Warden\'s uninstall protection was turned off. Re-enable it so the app cannot be removed before the lock ends.
A time lock is active, but the DNS filter stopped. Open Warden and restart protection.
